name: メッセージ消去期間の選択
prompt: Recreate only the Japanese message-retention selection component on an exact 390 × 246 white canvas. Use image 1 as the authority for layout, Japanese labels, selected state, spacing and color. Use image 2 only as source-app context; omit English labels and any app chrome. At x=30,y=8 show 「メッセージの保存期間」 in Meiryo Regular 12px/16px, quiet gray #6E6E6E. Place one pale-mint rounded panel #ECFDF5 at x=16,y=38,w=358,h=192. Inside it, show exactly four selectable rows with Meiryo Regular 14px/24px, dark #1D1D1D: 「24時間」 at y=50, 「7日間」 at y=96, 「90日間」 at y=142, and 「自動消去しない」 at y=188. Keep dividers at x=32, width=326, height=1, y=82/128/174/220, quiet #E8ECE9. The final 「自動消去しない」 row alone is selected and has the green #047857 check at x=345,y=195,size=18×13. Preserve the simple compact native layout with no added title, explanatory copy, shadows or borders beyond the specified dividers. There are no hyperlinks in this component; keep all option labels dark and only the selected check green, with no blue text.
reviewNotes: First pass preserves the four Japanese options and selected green check, with no blue link styling. It omits the heading, places the panel about 5px high and 10px short, uses heavier option lettering than Meiryo Regular, and adds a bottom divider that is absent in the native preview. Requires second pass.
